name: Access Control Reader Implant
description: Rather than cloning a single credential, a reader implant is placed on or behind an access control reader to harvest all credentials presented to it over time. The ESPKey taps the Wiegand data line between the reader and the control panel, capturing every card number presented. The Doppelganger board offers a more flexible platform for custom capture and relay scenarios. These implants provide a full credential harvest over the engagement window.

blue.det: Physical device discovery during security sweep; network anomaly from implant; WIDS detection; unusual RF emissions.
blue.cm: Regular physical security sweeps (RF, visual); TSCM (Technical Surveillance Countermeasures) for high-security areas; NAC preventing implant network access; WIDS for wireless implants; audit all network ports regularly.
